item.title: Unified Humanoid Whole-Body Control
item.description:
We are researching a unified whole-body control model that can generalize across humanoid robot platforms. The model accepts a robot’s hardware configuration as context, with the long-term goal of operating across embodiments without platform-specific fine-tuning.

NVIDIA GR00T is the current base model, although the method is designed to extend to other control architectures. Initial cross-platform generalization has been demonstrated, and work continues on robustness and transfer.
